facts.text: Bothell was incorporated in 1909 and grew from logging/farming to a bedroom community by mid‑20th century.
Bothell’s highest point, Nike Hill, once hosted a Nike missile silo and rises 510 feet above sea level.
Bothell’s name honors the Bothell family, whose first postmaster Gerhard Ericksen bought the boarding house that became the town’s namesake.
A permanent campus shared with Cascadia Community College opened in 2000 on a site originally slated for a shopping mall, which was blocked to protect nearby wetlands.
The Bothell Historical Museum sits in the Hannan House on Park at Bothell Landing and opens Sundays from April to October.
The city once had a railroad that brought passengers until 1938, and its early growth included telegraph, general store, butcher, and drugstore by the late 1880s.
